description: Defines the MojoAudioInputStream class which manages IPC for a single audio input stream, delegating to AudioInputDelegate, and handling stream creation, errors, and volume control.

classes.name: MojoAudioInputStream
classes.description: Handles IPC for a single audio input stream, manages delegate creation, stream events, and communication with clients.

methods.name: MojoAudioInputStream
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the audio input stream with callbacks and IPC receivers.

methods.name: SetOutputDeviceForAec
methods.description: Sets the output device for acoustic echo cancellation.

methods.name: SetVolume
methods.description: Sets the volume level for the audio stream.

methods.name: OnStreamCreated
methods.description: Handles the event when the stream is successfully created.

methods.name: OnError
methods.description: Closes connection and notifies owner of errors.
